@@ -41,3 +41,37 @@ def test_shebang_task_vars(fake_old_module_open, templar):
 
     (data, style, shebang) = modify_module('fake_module', 'fake_path', {}, templar, task_vars=task_vars)
     assert shebang == '#!/usr/bin/python3'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, expected', [
+    (b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -I\nfrom ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule\n', b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -I'),
+    (b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -X "dev mode"\nfrom ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule\n', b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -X "dev mode"'),
+    (b'from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule\n', b'#!/usr/bin/python'),
+])
+def test_new_style_shebang(tmp_path, templar, source, expected):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'sample.py'
+    module_path.write_bytes(source)
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('sample', str(module_path), {}, templar)
+    assert style == 'new'
+    assert data.startswith(expected + b'\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n')
+    assert shebang == expected.decode('utf-8')
+
+
+def test_new_style_interpreter_override(tmp_path, templar):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'sample.py'
+    module_path.write_bytes(b'#!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -I\nfrom ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule\n')
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('sample', str(module_path), {}, templar,
+                                         task_vars={'ansible_python_interpreter': '/usr/bin/python3'})
+    assert style == 'new'
+    assert shebang == '#!/usr/bin/python3 -I'
+    assert data.startswith(b'#!/usr/bin/python3 -I\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n')
+
+
+def test_old_style_preserves_shebang_and_args(tmp_path, templar):
+    module_path = tmp_path / 'sample'
+    source = b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w\nputs "hello"\n'
+    module_path.write_bytes(source)
+    data, style, shebang = modify_module('sample', str(module_path), {}, templar)
+    assert style == 'old'
+    assert shebang == '#!/usr/bin/ruby -w'
+    assert data == b'#!/usr/bin/ruby -w\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\nputs "hello"\n'
